name: Sanctum (Stromgarde Keep)
summary: Behind the chapel in Stromgarde Keep, the Sanctum remains a sacred refuge. It guards the way to the Trollbane family crypt amid Arathi's ruin.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Ruins
sections.body: Syndicate infiltrators and Boulderfist ogres have taken much of Stromgarde Keep. Yet defenders still hold the Sanctum and the chapel beside it. Behind the Church of Light, the Sanctum borders the keep's graveyard and marks the way into the royal crypt, where Stromgarde's kings rest. Prince Galen Trollbane's loyalists defend this ground to protect their kingdom's ancestral heritage and faith from the invaders.

sections.title: Threshold of the Kings
sections.body: Stone flags cover the passage into the royal tomb beneath the Sanctum. The ground is consecrated for quiet reflection and worship of the Holy Light. After King Thoras Trollbane's murder and Stromgarde's collapse, the Sanctum became a defensive retreat. Royal guards hold its halls against anyone seeking the inner tomb. At this sacred threshold, an ancient human lineage clings to survival.

faq.answer: The Sanctum lies behind the Church of Light's chapel within Stromgarde Keep. It adjoins the keep's graveyard and leads into the Trollbane family crypt.

faq.q: Who controls the Sanctum right now?
faq.answer: Surviving Stromgarde soldiers loyal to the Alliance and Prince Galen Trollbane hold the Sanctum. Human guards defend the chapel and Sanctum while Syndicate bandits and Boulderfist ogres overrun the rest of the ruined city.
The Trollbane family crypt lies beyond the Sanctum. It holds Stromgarde's fallen rulers, including the recently slain King Thoras Trollbane.

faq.q: Why is this area important to Stromgarde?
faq.answer: The Sanctum is consecrated for worship of the Holy Light and guards the resting place of Stromgarde's kings. Its defenders fight to keep invaders from desecrating their ancestors' graves.

angles.text: As a paladin, you find the chapel and Sanctum among the last undefiled sanctuaries of the Holy Light in Arathi's fallen capital. Defending them is a solemn duty.
As an Alliance member, you help hold the Trollbane ancestral seat and keep the Alliance presence alive in Stromgarde's contested ruins.
